note: At least one case per rule this pack writes out rather than takes over from the pack of the 2017 edition: a document of the conformance corpus, upgraded to this edition, that the rule is silent on, and the same document with one thing changed, that it speaks on. expect is what the pack reports about the second that it does not report about the first, onHolds what it reports about the first, and gone what the change takes away. No official validation artefact covers this edition, so a case shows that the engine decides what the rule was written to say and never that what was written is what the standard means.

standard.note: A standard rated invoice of the conformance corpus, upgraded to this edition, with the identification scheme this edition asks for on the seller identifier.

zero.note: The same invoice rewritten to the zero rate.

exempt.note: The same invoice rewritten to exempt from VAT, with the exemption reason the category asks for.

reverse.note: The same invoice rewritten to reverse charge, with the buyer VAT identifier and the exemption reason the category asks for.

intra.note: The same invoice rewritten to intra-community supply, with the buyer VAT identifier, the deliver to country, the delivery date and the exemption reason the category asks for.

export.note: The same invoice rewritten to an export outside the Union.

not-subject.note: The same invoice rewritten to not subject to VAT, which states no VAT rate.

canary.note: The same invoice rewritten to the Canary Islands general indirect tax at seven per cent.

ceuta.note: The same invoice rewritten to the tax on production, services and importation of Ceuta and Melilla at seven per cent.

national.note: The same invoice rewritten to a national or margin scheme category.

cannotBeExercised.why: A business group of an ESJ document exists exactly when it carries a value, and the invoice line period carries no business term other than the two dates this rule asks for: a period with neither of them is not an empty group but no group at all. The rule is in the pack because an invoice read from a syntax that can write the empty element is measured by it; no document of this format can make it speak.
